task.title: Installing OBS Studio
task.shortdesc: Download and install OBS Studio on Windows, macOS, or Linux.

context.p: The installer differs slightly per platform, but the first-run experience is the same everywhere: an Auto-Configuration Wizard benchmarks your hardware and proposes starting output settings.

step.cmd: Download the installer for your platform from the official OBS Studio site.

dlentry.dd: Run the .exe installer and accept the default install location unless you have a reason to change it.
Open the .dmg and drag OBS Studio into Applications.
Install via the distribution's package manager, Flatpak, or the official PPA, depending on your distribution.

step.cmd: Launch OBS Studio for the first time.

step.info: Choose Optimize for recording or Optimize for streaming depending on your primary use, then accept the benchmarked settings or adjust them.

taskbody.result: OBS Studio opens with a default scene collection and one empty scene, ready for you to add sources.
